mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace space JOIN workspace_member member ON member.workspace_id = space.workspace_id WHERE space.workspace_id = dataset.workspace_id AND space.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.user_key = #{userKey} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (space.owner_user_key = #{userKey} OR member.role_code = 'ADMIN' OR dataset.created_by = #{userKey}) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND
mapper.select: SELECT dataset_id FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT dataset.dataset_id, dataset.name, dataset.description, dataset.created_at, dataset.updated_at, space.workspace_id, space.name AS workspace_name, creator.user_id AS creator_user_id, creator.username AS creator_username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_image image WHERE image.dataset_id = dataset.dataset_id AND image.is_deleted = FALSE) AS image_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_file data_file WHERE data_file.dataset_id = dataset.dataset_id AND data_file.is_deleted = FALSE) AS file_count FROM dataset JOIN workspace space ON space.workspace_id = dataset.workspace_id JOIN workspace_member member ON member.workspace_id = space.workspace_id LEFT JOIN auth_user creator ON creator.user_key = dataset.created_by WHERE member.user_key = #{userKey} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND space.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: ORDER BY dataset.created_at DESC, dataset.dataset_id ASC, space.name, space.workspace_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset (dataset_id, name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, workspace_id) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{workspaceId})
